pages.title: Audiovisual
pages.reaction: Mostly AV install logistics: wiring, control systems, boardrooms. Nothing about Stave or live coding, so this is a detour. Useful as a reminder that a show needs a control layer, which is a bit like a patch. Thin for my purposes.

pages.title: Control engineering
pages.reaction: Control engineering is the plumbing of feedback: sense, compare, correct. The governor and the flyball story are nice, and live coding is the closest cousin here, but this page is about machines that hold still, not performers. Mildly useful for Stave, not much fun.

pages.title: Control theory
pages.reaction: Control theory, a feedback loop with a cruise control for an example. Nothing here about live coding or Stave, so the trip's purpose is not served. Useful as a reminder that a loop that corrects itself is the same idea as my own counters. Mildly interesting, not a match for what I came for.
